title: Audit: Find mismatches between visitorId and email usage
description: Use critique-waves technique to audit visitorId/email mismatches in queries and mutations.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create instructions.md with FORBIDDEN/REQUIRED patterns for visitorId/email
Create tracker.md with goal of 6 consecutive passes
Run waves of 3 parallel agents checking: (1) convex/ visitorId+email patterns, (2) src/ useVisitorId usage, (3) query cache keys
Continue until 6 consecutive passes or issues found

notes: CODE REVIEW ONLY - NO BROWSER. Use critique-waves technique: 3 agents max parallel, write to separate MD files, track consecutive passes. FORBIDDEN: using user.email as visitorId, using visitorId to query by email field. REQUIRED: consistent ID usage per query. Known issue: leaderboard.ts uses user.email as visitorId but practice data uses localStorage UUID.
